summary: Skyasterix shares his critical feedback on the Dragon Crown Homage and Eve of the Rift anniversary event, calling it toxic and unhealthy for the game. His main issue is that players could obtain multiple Legendary Hero Collection Chests without a strict cap, allowing some players to acquire multiple top-tier legendary selectors. In previous seasons, such chests were limited to one per account for the entire season. Additionally, the event suffered from technical freezes upon reset and coffer supplies sold out within 5 to 10 minutes. He advises the developers to cap such high-tier selector rewards at one per account in future events.
tips: High-impact selector rewards like the Legendary Hero Collection Chest create severe account disparity if not strictly limited to one per account per season.
title: 🔥 The MOST TOXIC Event?! ⚠️ Dragon Crown Homage – My Honest Opinion! | Dragonheir: Silent Gods
